bio: Dr. Gowthami Namballa is an obstetrician and gynecologist in Visakhapatnam with over 10 years of experience in women's health.
She cares for women at every stage of life, from routine check-ups and pregnancy to specialist gynecological treatment.
Her team works to make each visit calm and private, so you can speak openly and trust the plan you agree on together.
